scope: Shared candidate-window viewing state for normal browsing and editing; no generator or star-data changes

checks: view controls are available outside editing and the saved draw replays unchanged
zoom changes projection scale while leaving physical stars, display enhancement, figures and favourites unchanged
buttons, slider, wheel and reset agree, enforce zoom limits and keep the page still while scrolling over the chart
normal viewing supports accurate star picking after zoom and pan, without a spurious click when a drag ends
entering editing retains the viewing scale and positions; editing pans only the view and creates no draft history
zoomed background stars can join the figure; undo, redo, tool changes and confirmation preserve the viewport and original favourite
cancel and regional regeneration retain the view without affecting confirmed data or disabling navigation afterwards
boundary handles still take precedence over view dragging at the zoomed position
switching candidates or rounds resets the view and all fifteen candidates retain a common baseline angular scale
390px viewing and editing controls fit the screen, with correct star picking after zoom
built-in initial charts support zoom and a reload restores the saved figure without persisting viewport changes
DPR 2 canvas uses full backing resolution and CSS-coordinate picking remains accurate at 3x zoom
DPR 2 editing preserves the projection and hit location, and cancellation clears the tool highlight

automatedGeometry.scope: Stereographic pointer inverse away from center and across RA seam

independentReview: Read-only scout checked the shared view, drawing and hit coordinates, edit transitions, event precedence and busy-state controls; no confirmed new issue. Actual browser checks and final validation performed by the primary agent.
initialAttempts: First browser attempt could not connect because the local preview server was stopped; restarted it on loopback port 8765.
A subsequent attempt timed out before module initialization without a JavaScript error. The next run with request diagnostics completed all 12 browser checks, followed by the two DPR 2 checks.
limitations: Viewing uses the existing stereographic projection and retains its peripheral distortion and antipodal singularity.
The viewport is temporary display state, not persisted in the constellation recipe or favourites.
Multi-finger touch zoom is not implemented; buttons and slider remain available on touch screens.
